description: Fix a container/heap priority queue that breaks ties by comparing payload fields directly (no FIFO guarantee) into an insertion-order-stable one
prompts: pq.go implements heap.Interface directly over Priority alone - Less(i, j) only compares Priority, so container/heap makes NO guarantee about the relative order of equal-priority items (heap operations can and do reorder them). Fix it so that: (1) items with a lower Priority number come out first, and (2) items with EQUAL Priority always come out in the order they were originally pushed (FIFO) - add an explicit monotonically increasing insertion-order field to Item and use it as the tiebreaker in Less.
name: add_go_stable_priority_queue
